# AgentSkin 5.1
AgentSkin is context middleware for AI agents.
Primary MCP tools: compress, fetch_optimized_data, reduce.
Compatibility tools: apply_json_semantic, classify_url, strip_ansi, estimate_tokens, skin_reasoning.
Rule: fidelity first, compression second.
Install: npx -y agentskin@latest
Source: https://github.com/Shawn5cents/agentskin
